nodes.title: Ambush!
nodes.description: Something lunges from the shadows. Steel or spell — choose fast.

Fight.success: You cut it down. Loot recovered.
Fight.failure: It lands a blow. Strike taken.

Flee.failure: It clips you as you run. Strike taken.

nodes.title: Dusty Chest
nodes.description: A battered chest sits against the wall. Could be riches. Could be a trap.

nodes.title: Wandering Peddler
nodes.description: A hooded figure offers wares from a battered pack. Prices seem fair. Maybe.

nodes.title: Pressure Plate
nodes.description: Your foot hovers over a suspicious stone. One wrong step and this gets ugly.

Step Carefully.success: You disarm it with a steady hand.

nodes.title: Hidden Alcove
nodes.description: A quiet nook, hidden from the dungeon's main path. You could rest here.
